Name: Pookachu's Overly Insane Greenhouse
Author: Pookachutf
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]A greenhouse designed to hold all the crops/trees from Bonster's Crops Combined mod.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Check to make sure you don't have another greenhouse mod. Drop unzipped mod into the mod folder for SDV[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]7x7 plots for the "non trellis" crops, special easy to access plots for the trellis crops. Holds 2 of each tree. [/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]SMAPI, Content Patcher. Recommend Bonster's Crops Combined. [/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Thanks Bonster for making so many excellent crops/trees.[/size][/color]
